    def setMyDriver(self, aNewMyDriver):

            return False
        existingMySubordinate = aNewMyDriver.getMySubordinate()
        if existingMySubordinate is not None and existingMySubordinate is not self:
            return False

        self._myDriver.setMySubordinate(self)
        if anOldMyDriver is not None:
            anOldMyDriver.setMySubordinate(None)
        return True

    def delete(self):

        self._myDriver = None
        if existingMyDriver is not None:
            existingMyDriver.setMySubordinate(None)
